none: PAS FindID 998760: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Two small Victories facing each other holding up wreaths. Vertical fir between Victories. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD]AV[GGQ NN]. In exergue: [T]RS. Diameter: 14.7mm, Weight: 1.05gms, die axis: 6
